  - Heading: `### 4.2-NOW LEADING CANONICAL — now() / current_timestamp / current_date + Iceberg timestamptz is UTC-NORMALIZED on storage`.
  - Keyword anchors blockquote covering: Trino now(), now() Trino, does Trino have now, now() vs current_timestamp, current_timestamp Trino, current_date Trino, current_time Trino, localtimestamp Trino, session time zone Trino, what time zone does Trino store, Iceberg timestamp storage, Iceberg timestamptz storage, timestamp with time zone UTC, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE Iceberg, UTC-normalized, stored as UTC, wall-clock timestamp, AT TIME ZONE Trino, timezone aware vs naive Iceberg, timestamp vs timestamptz.
  - Two load-bearing facts: (1) Trino HAS now() — it IS an alias for current_timestamp; both return TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE as of query start, tied to SESSION time zone; current_date → DATE, current_time → TIME WITH TIME ZONE, localtimestamp → TIMESTAMP (no TZ); current_timestamp/current_date/current_time/localtimestamp take NO parens; now() takes empty parens; current_timestamp() is a parse error. (2) Iceberg STORAGE: a `timestamp(6) with time zone` (timestamptz) column is UTC-NORMALIZED on disk per the Iceberg spec (stored as microseconds from epoch UTC; original zone NOT preserved per value — it's an instant). A `timestamp(6)` (WITHOUT time zone) column is wall-clock with NO normalization. `AT TIME ZONE` re-labels the same UTC instant in the target zone (cross-ref §4.2B core semantic) — does NOT change stored bytes.
  - 5-claim DO-NOT-WRITE: (i) `Trino has no now() — use current_timestamp instead` = FALSE; (ii) `now() is a parse error / function-not-found` = FALSE; (iii) `Iceberg/Trino never normalizes timestamps to UTC on storage — you get back exactly what you stored` = FALSE for timestamptz (true ONLY for bare timestamp without TZ); (iv) `current_timestamp and now() return different types/values` = FALSE; (v) `current_date returns a timestamp` = FALSE (returns DATE).
  - Cross-refs: §4.2A (SET TIME ZONE command), §4.2B (timestamptz filtering boundary-literal), r13 timestamp-type-mapping and from_unixtime.
  - WebSearch-verified at trino.io/docs/current/functions/datetime.html (quote: "now() → timestamp with time zone — This is an alias for current_timestamp") + Iceberg spec via WebSearch (quote: "values are stored as UTC and do not retain a source time zone").
